g.text: Scale-out fabric: how much InfiniBand was used?
Eight active 400-Gb/s GPU-fabric ports per node · TX only · common ≈10s sampling
Node denominator: 8 × 400 Gb/s = 3.2 Tb/s one-way. Hot-port denominator: 400 Gb/s. Storage ports excluded.
First rollout through last model save/train end. Sampled utilization is not a 1→2→4-node scaling curve; coarse bins hide bursts.
